name: Reina's Desire
source:
You start a thrilling journey leaving your hometown behind to pursue your dreams in a new city. Filled with anticipation and excitement, you enroll in the university and join the prestigious hockey team, eager to make a name for yourself.

Upon your arrival, you quickly become acquainted with an array of captivating women, each possessing their own unique personalities and stories. Through chance encounters and shared moments, these women will shape your journey, leaving an indelible mark on your life as well as your body.

Beneath the surface of seemingly ordinary routines and friendly faces, dark secrets and mysteries lurk, shattering the illusion of normalcy.

In a city where nothing is as it seems, you must navigate a path filled with love, ambition, and sex.

[From [url=https://puppiesandboobies.itch.io/reinalevel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你告别故乡，踏上一段激动人心的旅程，前往一座陌生的城市追逐梦想。怀揣着满腔期待与热忱，你步入大学校园，加入了声名显赫的校冰球队，渴望在这里闯出一番名堂。

初来乍到，你很快便结识了一众魅力非凡的女性，她们性格各异，各自有着不为人知的故事。在一次次偶然邂逅与朝夕相处之中，这些女性将深刻影响你的旅途，在你的人生与身体上留下难以磨灭的印记。

然而，在看似平淡的日常与友善的面孔之下，阴暗的秘密与重重谜团正悄然潜伏，将平静的假象击得粉碎。

在这座表里不一的城市里，你必须在交织着爱恋、野心与情欲的道路上摸索前行。
